item.description:
Fixes for the ten days since 0.6.1, many of them from people who sent pull requests, and spreadsheets and presentations as a new kind of file.

Fixed

  • Battery drain after the first pass: a folder where something rewrites files all the time no longer makes DigUp re-scan everything, and iCloud Drive or Google Drive folders no longer make every scan take minutes.
  • A folder you chose is read whole, whatever it holds; a home folder with its dotfiles in git used to count as a code project.
  • Settings → Folders says why files aren't searchable: "N not read" next to each folder opens the reasons.
  • The progress bar no longer starts over when new files arrive mid-pass, and Resume right after Pause starts indexing again.
  • The search panel opens over a fullscreen app while a DigUp window is open, instead of switching Spaces.
  • A PDF with broken metadata no longer crashes indexing; copy-protected songs are skipped instead of failing one by one.
  • The "Open code in" picker follows what you choose.
  • Keyword search is faster on big indexes.
  • Tiny stub files no longer top generic searches like "config" or "test".
  • Code search no longer runs a repository's own configured git programs (a security fix).

New

  • Spreadsheets and presentations: xlsx, pptx, ods and odp are read for their text.
  • Typst files are indexed as documents.
  • Skip a Folder… on the Code tab. Folders with a CACHEDIR.TAG stay out of both indexes.
  • The Welcome screen says what the folders step does before it runs. The menu bar icon is the logo.

Fixes for what people ran into in the first week, and a few additions.

  • Korean, Japanese and Chinese typing works in the search field, and folders with accents or Korean in their names index again.
  • A word that's in your files only as the start of a longer one ("Grok" in "Grok4") stays found after you stop typing.
  • Indexing keeps going while your folders change, skips a file that runs away, and quits with DigUp.
  • Scanned PDF pages are read with text recognition, so a number on a scan is found when you type it, and SVG pictures are read too.
  • New in Settings: index only at set hours, and Use Files… for a model downloaded elsewhere.
  • Time estimates fit your Mac, Settings scrolls with many folders, and the search panel fades in and out.

The first public release of DigUp, built on Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.

  • Pictures, screenshots, PDFs, documents, audio and video, found by describing them. Long PDFs and documents are read to the end.
  • Exact words count too: invoice numbers, error codes and names, including the text inside screenshots.
  • Code search, off until you choose folders for it: start a search with code:. With it on, the search field shows a code: example.
  • Updates like this one arrive by themselves: a daily check you can turn off in Settings.
